- Key Route Segments & Course Bearings:

  * Segment 2: 3.8 NM on course 270° (W) from (50.7300, -1.3900) to (50.7100, -1.4800)
  * Segment 3: 2.5 NM on course 220° (SW) from (50.7100, -1.4800) to (50.7050, -1.5000)

Forecast wind is from 265° at 20 knots. Search sailing directions for Solent western passage hazards and evaluate adverse winds along planned route segments.
